text: yeah the color map picker still problematic and massive churn. esc key problem is fixed
resolution: Fixed the remaining OKLCH color-map churn in cart/editor. Drag samples now stay inside a frame-coalesced local preview subtree; the GPU map nodes, AppFrame state, ModelView brush sync, hot state, persistence, and derived color library remain untouched until pointer-up commits one settled color. Hex entry now commits on finish rather than pushing intermediate valid text. ReleaseFast editor ship and tsc-check pass. User visual/perf verification requested: drag map and chroma continuously with spikewatch armed for 60s; marker/readout must stay live, brush color must update once on release, and no rhythmic spike/lockup may appear.
